scope: New voices in contemporary sculpture. Artists new to Atrium, with regional and material variety, clear attribution and commercially reusable model files. Reviewed locally; publication authorized 2026-09-08.
rights_note: Per-model licenses verified from current primary metadata. Preserve underlying artwork credits and rights separately. Do not use lesser known as a public label or make unsupported claims about artists’ prominence.
archive: Public Objaverse 1.0 GLBs matched to current Sketchfab metadata by UID.

works.title: Ball Games
works.museum: Public art near an elementary school, Ústí nad Labem (capture location)
works.capture: Pavel Matoušek’s capture of a public relief showing children playing with a ball, made near an elementary school in Ústí nad Labem in November 2019. The contributor dates the artwork to the 1980s. Exact material and dimensions are unrecorded.
works.evidence: Artist, subject, decade and location come from the primary scan contributor. Do not confuse this attribution with the younger sculptor Václav Kyselka, born in 1975. The English title follows the source model title.

works.title: Ceramic Mosaic Relief
works.museum: Stříbrnická elementary school, Ústí nad Labem (capture location)
works.capture: Pavel Matoušek’s capture of the ceramic relief at the entrance to Stříbrnická elementary school. The repeated rounded forms and a section of the brick wall are included. The source dates the work to 1983. This is an architectural surface capture; the back of the wall was not recorded.
works.evidence: Primary contributor gives artist, 1983 date, ceramic medium and school. Title is descriptive. Converted the legacy specular-glossiness material to current glTF materials while retaining the source colour texture.

works.title: Ježek (Hedgehog)
works.museum: Park Republiky, Ústí nad Labem (capture location)
works.capture: Pavel Matoušek’s September 2021 capture shows the public sculpture shortly after repainting, with brightly coloured spines. The original creation date is unrecorded; 2021 is the capture and repainting year. A small area of the ground is included.
works.evidence: Primary contributor names Karel Kučera and identifies the park and freshly repainted state. Drobné památky independently records the artist and concrete material. No creation date is inferred from the scan title.

works.title: Dvojice (The Couple)
works.capture: Pavel Matoušek’s November 2019 capture of Michael Bílek’s public sculpture, including the embracing figures, their base and a small area of paving. The contributor dates it to the 1980s. Exact material and dimensions are unrecorded for this capture.
works.evidence: Primary scan identifies artist, title and 1980s. The regional museum documents Bílek’s public sculpture practice and a marble Dvojice for Hotel Vladimir in 1987, but the scan labels its location City council. Kept the contributor’s decade and city; did not transplant hotel-specific date, material or dimensions without establishing the exact match.

works.title: To the Letters
works.museum: Gardens of the National Palace of Culture, Sofia
works.capture: Independent capture of the monumental column of Cyrillic letters in the gardens of Sofia’s National Palace of Culture. The contributor records the title To the Letters and dates it to 1982. The pedestal is included.
works.evidence: Source model gives G. Malakchiev, title, 1982 and location. Bulgaria’s National Gallery identifies the artist in full as Galin Malakchiev and documents this monumental work at the same site. Exact material and physical dimensions are not established.

works.title: Veuve Clicquot Jerrycan
works.capture: Paspro360’s 3D representation of Erik Salin’s pop-art sculpture, which combines a fuel-can form with champagne branding. The publisher links to the original George Thornton Art listing; the gallery’s Artsy record dates it to 2020.
works.evidence: Model credits Erik Salin and links the original gallery work. George Thornton Art’s Artsy listing supplies 2020, mixed media and 20 × 20 inches. The artist’s site corroborates the Jerrycan series. This low-polygon model is a representation, not claimed to be a detailed photogrammetric scan.

works.title: Love Balloon
works.capture: Paspro360’s 3D representation of a red Love Balloon on a red base. The publisher links to George Thornton Art, whose listings credit Géraldine Morin and date the work to 2021. The thin balloon string and base are included.
works.evidence: Primary model links the original gallery listing. George Thornton Art’s Artsy record gives artist, 2021 and 52 × 15 inches; its archived dealer listing on 1stDibs explicitly describes the red balloon and red base. The current gallery page depicts a green variant. Retained the source-linked gallery’s sole-artist credit rather than applying joint credits from listings of different later variants.

works.title: Subling
works.capture: Official Scottish Maritime Museum scan of one of fifty ceramic submarines made by Tom McKendrick in 1990 for Glasgow’s year as European City of Culture. The small sculpture includes exaggerated rivets, hatches and a copper-coloured propeller.
works.evidence: Museum’s primary model explicitly supplies title, artist, ceramic medium, 1990 date, edition of 50 and collection. Digitised through Scanning the Horizon. Model file is CC0, distinct from the CC BY files elsewhere in this batch.
